digest.component_or_area: reconciler mode ranking and comparison operators
propositions: Mode inherits from str and Enum, causing functools.total_ordering to fail to override str's lexical comparison methods, resulting in rank-based comparisons like Mode.BOOTSTRAP_THROTTLE > Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK evaluating incorrectly.
The check_phase_gate function fails to block higher reconciler modes when the stored gate is set to reconcile-check due to incorrect comparison ordering.
Rich comparison operators (__gt__, __le__, __ge__) must be explicitly implemented to use rank-based _ORDERED contract instead of inherited string lexical ordering.
The five-mode ordering contract (reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live) must be enforced across all comparison operators and tested comprehensively.
Persisted Mode values, enum identities, MODE_CAPS dictionary, from_str parsing, and existing string representations must remain unchanged.
